notes: All story flags (Revision 2). role=record = no script reads it yet (journal, achievements, future hooks). Trust is NOT a flag: trust.<npc_id> for npcs[] (carly, wraith, ross, wes, ...). Ambient/trader standing uses *_rep flags. Enum flags start null unless a default is given. set_in/read_in are auto-generated. No medical-clock checkpoint rules exist in Revision 2; the Pearce family modifier is read only by the epilogue.
pearce_family_modifier: Pearce family modifier (all endings): reads ross_alive, wes_alive, pearce_reconciled. Epilogue: letter+reunion / letter / one-line letter / news of Ross's death. No death checkpoint.

ames_alive.meaning: Dr. Ames survives (no default death path; levels read it in Ch10).

ames_trade_hinted.meaning: Braith suspects Ames trades with the Viaduct Crew.

ander_alive.meaning: Ander survives (no default death path; reserved).

annex_known.meaning: Braith knows the Dixie Valley Annex exists and what it is.

annex_told.meaning: Whether Braith told Ross/the Compact what the Annex holds.

assimilated_killed.meaning: Hollows (assimilated_human / assimilated_animal) killed in dialogue; engine adds 1 per kill. Separate from tallmen_killed. No total exists.

assimilation_discovered.meaning: Braith has seen a Hollow (assimilated person) and knows what they are (Ch8).

augie_broadcast.meaning: What Augie told the valley in Ch7.

augie_heard.meaning: Heard Augie's broadcast in the line.

augie_lie_known.meaning: Braith knows Augie invents good news.

avila_stance.meaning: Which chain of command Avila obeys after Ch6.

boone_exposed.meaning: Braith exposed Boone to Ruiz; Kessler shot him.

bridge_choice.meaning: Ch6 rail trench: freight car dropped (blocked) or Bradley let through (open). Internal name kept from v1.

cards_installed.meaning: Annex control cards installed at Galena.

carly_count_doubt.meaning: Carly doubts Avila's count (Ch2, if Braith told her).

carly_found_count.meaning: Carly found the falsified stores sheets (Ch3).

carly_left.meaning: Carly left Braith at the end of Ch6 (trust.carly<=-3). She survives and sits at her faction's table.

ch01_fuel_to_pruitt.meaning: Gave the gas can for Mr. Pruitt's oxygen concentrator.

ch01_gas_choice.meaning: Where the gas can went in Ch1.

ch01_gil_traded.meaning: Traded the flight-line tools to Gil for diesel.

ch01_kit_let_go.meaning: Braith let Kit leave with goods.

ch01_knows_gil_siphoned.meaning: Braith noticed Gil's siphoned Maverik diesel.

ch01_pharmacy_choice.meaning: How the pharmacy encounter with Kit ended.

ch01_scarf_found.meaning: Wraith tracked Mr. Pruitt (companion tutorial done).

ch02_avila_truth.meaning: Braith knows the real stores count (41 days).

ch02_covered_kit.meaning: Covered for Kit in the ration line.

ch02_crush_helped.meaning: Pulled Mateo out of the crush.

ch02_exposed_numbers.meaning: Braith shouted the real number in public.

ch02_haas_bribed.meaning: Bribed Cpl. Haas at the checkpoint.

ch02_kit_tip.meaning: Kit warned Braith not to give names.

ch02_reported_gil.meaning: Named Gil as a hoarder. Big delayed consequence.

ch03_helped_gil.meaning: Braith (and Carly) went out during the fire.

ch03_kit_warned.meaning: Kit warned Braith about the raid.

ch03_wes_stayed.meaning: Wes stayed a week in Sparks in Ch3.

ch06_bradley_tip.meaning: Ruiz told Braith about the freight car (engine: mark safe route).

ch06_hid_neighbors.meaning: Hid the Pruitts' food and Lolo's morphine during the sweep.

ch09_ruiz_gap.meaning: Passed the picket by Ruiz's gap.

ch09_voice_followed.meaning: Braith followed the voice off the rope in the Ch9 whiteout (cost one column member).

ch09_wraith_hold.meaning: Braith ordered Wraith to hold the line on the ice (she dies).

dam_running.meaning: Galena Station is generating (internal name kept from v1). False after the December 5 bursts until control cards are installed.

dam_secret_told.meaning: Who was told about Galena in Ch3 (internal name kept from v1).

darlene_with_mo.meaning: Darlene moved to Mo's truck stop.

den_killed.meaning: Killed the two sleeping Tallmen at the hot-springs den. Eases the Ch10 siege.

dutch_betrayed.meaning: Dutch sold Braith's route (Ch4 ambush happened).

fired_on_blockade.meaning: Braith escorted the convoy and fired on the Compact (his father's line).

gil_badly_burned.meaning: Gil burned with no help; dies at end of Ch6.

gil_knows_report.meaning: Gil saw Braith's name on the informant list.

gpu_method.meaning: How Braith took the ground power cart.

haas_rep.meaning: Cpl. Haas's opinion (minor). >=1: he waves Braith through without a search.

has_gas_mask.meaning: Braith has his Air Force gas mask from his deployment bag. Set at the start of Ch8. mask_filter cartridges load into it (FILTER on the HUD).

husks_talked_down.meaning: Husks talked down. Adds to column_size.

ironwood_arrived.meaning: Task Force Ironwood is in the valley.

ironwood_hostility.meaning: How much Task Force Ironwood considers Braith an enemy. >=3 hostile patrols; >=5 gate battle in Ch10 regardless.

kindness.meaning: Small costly kindnesses. Gates husk talk-downs (>=4) and the council option (>=5).

kit_scouted_known.meaning: Braith knows Kit scouted Gil's garage.

lolo_alive.meaning: Lolo survives (false if trust.lolo<=-1 after the list).

lonnie_fed.meaning: Gave Lonnie food in the line.

lunds_stayed.meaning: The Lund family stays at Galena as crew.

lusk_rep.meaning: Deputy Lusk's opinion of Braith (ambient NPC). >=1: Lusk comes to Galena in Act III.

mimic_let_in.meaning: Braith opened the shelter door to the midnight mimic in Ch8. The hurt boy can't march: column_size -1 at Ch9 start.

pearce_reconciled.meaning: Pearce family modifier: true at end of Ch7 if NOT fired_on_blockade AND (wes_spared OR ross_goodbye=honest).

pete_lund_recovered.meaning: Pete Lund was the Ch8 husk and was talked down.

pruitt_alive.meaning: Mr. Pruitt survived Act I (resolved at end of Ch1 = ch01_fuel_to_pruitt).

recovery_detail_outcome.meaning: How the Annex recovery detail ended.

relay_source.meaning: Where Unit 1's protective relay came from.

rep_authority.meaning: Standing with the Truckee Meadows Recovery Authority.

rep_harbor.meaning: Standing with the Floor (internal id harbor).

reyne_secret_known.meaning: Reyne admitted leaving the outer door open.

ross_goodbye.meaning: How Braith said goodbye in Fallon (Ch7).

ross_met.meaning: Met Ross at the Ch5 blockade.

roz_guns_known.meaning: Braith knows the Floor buys guns.

ruiz_list_seen.meaning: Ruiz told Braith about her pencil marks.

ruiz_spared.meaning: Braith freed Ruiz from the MRAP door.

salt_fed.meaning: Fed Salt or left him a flashlight; he survives to Ch9.

shelter_sealed.meaning: Braith sealed the current shelter's windows with plastic/tarp. HUD SEAL is that shelter's seal %; it reduces indoor radiation and hides heat from Tallmen. Break-ins and broken windows lower SEAL.

siege_breaches.meaning: Times the lamp line broke in Ch10. Each = one named survivor lost in the epilogue census.

switchboard_built.meaning: Carly and Augie's radio relay is running (Ch6).

tallman_glimpses.meaning: Glimpses seen (tallman_glimpse set pieces + scripted moments). Journal/achievement.

tallman_seen_with_ruiz.meaning: Ruiz saw the alley Tallman with Braith.

tallmen_killed.meaning: Tallmen killed (dialogue + engine on each kill). >=2 (or den_killed) skips siege night 1. The total number at large is UNKNOWN by design.

trader_boone_rep.meaning: Boone's opinion; Act II access without an ID.

trader_floor_rep.meaning: Standing with the Floor's quartermaster table.

trader_mo_rep.meaning: Mo's opinion; standing credit at the truck stop.

trader_rourke_rep.meaning: Rourke's opinion; better stories, better stock.

walt_alive.meaning: Walt alive; always false after Ch9.

walt_recruited.meaning: Walt brought Braith in on Galena.

wes_crossed_off.meaning: Wes is on Lolo's 'if it comes to it' page (Ch8).

wes_spared.meaning: Wes is with Braith (treated in Ch5, or freed by Ruiz/at the Ch10 gate).

wraith_alive.meaning: Wraith is alive. Set false ONLY by dialogue/ch09_wraith_hold (signposted, confirmed).

wraith_injured.meaning: Wraith is hurt: limps, can't TRACK. Set by the Ch6 GUARD order or engine at 0 HP; cleared by vet_kit/rest. Gates ch09_wraith_hold.

wraith_led.meaning: Wraith led the column through the Ch9 whiteout.

wraith_mimic_warned.meaning: Wraith has growled a Hollow off at least once (journal; tutorializes the tell).
